sentences.text:
Malothu Sakram vs The State Of Telangna on 10 July, 2025
 The Honourable Sri Justice N.V.Shravan Kumar
 Writ Petition No.19825 of 2025
Order:

entities.text: Malothu Sakram vs The State Of Telangna
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Revenue appearing for respondent Nos.1, 2 and 5, Ms.Roohi Nabeela, learned Assistant Government for Panchayat Raj appearing for respondent No.3, learned Assistant Government for Roads and Buildings appearing for respondent No.4 and learned standing counsel for MPP appearing for respondent No.6.
With their consent, the writ petition is being taken up for disposal at the admission stage itself.

2. This writ petition has been filed seeking the following prayer:-
"to declare inaction of the respondents mainly the 2nd respondent who laid the road in the agricultural lands in Sy No.83 of Nelapatla Revenue village of Kusumanchi Mandal without any notice or land acquisition proceedings is as illegal, improper,
highly arbitrary, unconstitutional, without jurisdiction, violating the Article 14 to 21 and 300A of Constitution of India as well the natural justice, and prima-facio it is shows infirmity and biased, as abuse of process of law, thereby it is condonmed,
CONSEQUENTLY direct the respondents to pay the compensation under the "Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013"aquire the private agricultural lands of the petitioner in Sy No.83 Nelapatla Revenue villiage of Kusumanchi Mandal, while disposing the representation on 24.03.2025."

3. Though various grounds are raised in the writ petition, learned counsel for the petitioner restricts his prayer seeking a direction to respondent authorities to dispose the petitioner's representation dated 24.03.2025, in a time bound period.

4. Learned counsel appearing for respondents submits that if the petitioner's representation dated 24.03.2025 is still pending for consideration; the respondent authorities may be directed to dispose of the said representation and pass appropriate orders in accordance with law.
5.

In view of the submission made by learned counsel appearing on either side and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this writ petition is disposed of directing the respondent authorities to dispose the petitioner's representation dated 24.03.2025 and after giving fair opportunity of hearing to the petitioner and after considering the objection of the petitioner,
respondent authorities shall pass appropriate orders strictly in accordance with law, as expeditiously as possible, preferably within a period of eight (08) weeks from the date of receipt of copy of this order and communicate the same to the petitioner.
6.
Accordingly this writ petition is disposed of.

Miscellaneous applications, if any pending, shall Malothu Sakram vs The State Of Telangna on 10 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/95951210/
1 stand closed.
